rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone who readily lets others have their way, such as a permissive parent.

example.english: He is so indulgent toward his daughter that she always gets her way.
example.traditional: 佢個女成日扭計，佢都咁縱容，真係冇佢符。
example.jyutping: keoi5 go3 neoi2 seng4 jat6 nau2 gai2 keoi5 dou1 gam3 zung3 jung4 zan1 hai6 mou5 keoi5 fu4

rows.note: Use this when the indulgence involves pampering or spoiling someone, especially a child or family member.

example.english: My aunt is so indulgent that she pampers her daughter with designer goods.
example.traditional: 阿姨成日買名牌畀個女，真係寵到不得了。
example.jyutping: aa3 ji1 seng4 jat6 maai5 ming4 paai4 bei2 go3 neoi2 zan1 hai6 cung2 dou3 bat1 dak1 liu5

rows.note: Use this for excessive parental or romantic affection that leads someone to indulge the other person.

example.english: His parents are too indulgent and do everything for him, leaving him unable to look after himself.
example.traditional: 父母太溺愛個仔，乜都代佢做，搞到佢冇自理能力。
example.jyutping: fu6 mou5 taai3 nik6 oi3 go3 zai2 mat1 dou1 doi6 keoi5 zou6 gaau2 dou3 keoi5 mou5 zi6 lei5 nang4 lik6
